column3: “finely woven garments” renders “garments of serad,” a word whose meaning is uncertain.
“the skillfully woven band” renders “hesheb,” the band, and “of the same material” renders “from it.”
“mounted” renders “filled”; the identification of the gems in verses 10–13 is uncertain.
“a diamond” renders “yahalom,” a stone whose identity is uncertain.
“a beryl” renders “tarshish,” a stone whose identity is uncertain.
“of woven work” renders “the work of a weaver,” and “all of blue” renders “entirely of violet.”
NASB supplies “at the top”; “a coat of mail” renders “tahra,” a rare word whose meaning is uncertain.
“finely woven linen” renders “fine linen, the work of a weaver.”
“the decorated caps” renders “the head-wraps of the headdresses.”
“the holy crown” renders “the crown of holiness,” and “Holy to the LORD” renders “holiness to the LORD.”
